valuation.method: REIT AFFO per share x multiple: FY2027 AFFO/share (company calls 2026 the trough, with inflection in 2027) times a justified P/AFFO at the 12-month target date. FY2026 guidance midpoint $11.10 (range $11.04-$11.16) is the anchor; FY2027 is my assumption, not company guidance. No FX: USD-listed common shares.

bear.driver: No 2027 recovery: AFFO/share only +0.9% on 2026 midpoint as remaining DISH churn, higher interest cost and weak organic billings offset buybacks

base.driver: 2027 inflection as company indicates: AFFO/share +5.4% from 2026 midpoint on escalators, lower churn, data center growth and buybacks

bull.driver: Stronger carrier amplification and data center growth plus rate relief: AFFO/share +9% on 2026 midpoint

valuation.implied_by_close: At base AFFO $11.70 the close implies 15.7x; the equal-weight mean of the four named targets (about $210; not a weighted target because horizons are undocumented) implies roughly 17.9x base AFFO, or about $12.00 AFFO at 17.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/AFFO moves the base target by $11.70 (6.4 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Organic tenant billings growth ex-DISH and full-year 2027 AFFO per share guidance versus $11.70
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4/FY2026 results and 2027 outlook, expected around late February 2027; date not yet confirmed

analyst_notes: Only a subset of named calls could be sourced (4 analysts, mostly late-July post-Q2 and one Sep 30), so none were updated after the Oct 27 Q3 release and all are stale relative to earnings; the newest named target is Barclays $199. Targets of $195-$227 imply roughly 17-19.4x my $11.70 AFFO, versus 17.5x in the base case; the gap to the base is a mix of higher AFFO or multiple and is not attributable to any broker without their models. Wolfe (Buy, $188, Jul 9), Bernstein (Outperform, $207, May 19) and Deutsche Bank (initiation, Buy, $222, Nov 2026) were found without a named analyst and are excluded; target horizons are undocumented so all targets are excluded from the weighted target. Dividend assumes four $1.79 payments held flat (company raises have occurred annually, so this is conservative).
